components.css: .ds-project-card { position: relative; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.97); border: 1px solid rgba(84, 118, 171, 0.26); border-radius: 1.1rem; padding: 1.2rem 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 24px 48px -34px rgba(18, 39, 74, 0.28); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: transform 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-project-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%; width: 95%; height: 0.25rem; transform: translateX(-50%); border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.78), rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.1)); } .ds-project-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.24 0.031 257); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.65; color: oklch(0.38 0.03 255); margin: 0; }

components.name: Language Toggle
components.description: Pill button for opening the language menu.
components.css: .ds-lang-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.72rem 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(94, 126, 177, 0.3); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(246, 250, 255, 0.96); color: oklch(0.24 0.031 257); font-weight: 600; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.16s, border-color 0.16s; } .ds-lang-toggle:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.4); }

narrative.overview: The Precision Lab represents a refined, rigorous technical identity tailored for recruiters and engineering leaders. The interface balances high-density information architecture with tactile, luminous depth.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast dual-pane layout with atmospheric diagonal accent geometry.
Luminous tactile cards with subtle top accent gradients and soft ambient elevation.
Micro-interactions on interactive cards and language switchers.
Uncompromising typography pairing: geometric clarity in Inter for body, grounded authority in Merriweather Sans for headers.

rules.name: The Dual-Stage Contrast Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces strictly house identity, navigation, and compact profile metadata; luminous light surfaces house long-form project and experience narratives.

rules.name: The Micro-Lift Rule
rules.body: Interactive cards and buttons lift by exactly -1px on hover with a cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) easing curve.

dos: Do maintain strict visual and spatial parity when switching between Lithuanian (LT) and English (EN).
Do preserve the crisp dual-stage architecture (dark sticky sidebar, luminous main stage).
Do use Merriweather Sans exclusively for headers and Inter for data/body content.
donts: Don't introduce heavy, opaque drop shadows or flat unstyled gray borders.
Don't clutter project cards with raw unformatted walls of text.
